groups.status: author proposal only; all holds retained

source_relative_argument.native_question: All 25 exact Songololo keys have the native interior kind for original AGO ADM1 Zaire, feature ordinal 17, negative ordinal 1. The COD target remains in the original frozen land support. The other four retained operands have empty kinds at these keys. This isolates a specific incompatible source representation; it does not decide sovereignty or erase the original operands.
source_relative_argument.historical_rule: Actual BOC1913 Section B, printed 955–965, describes Noqui–Kwango using surveyed markers, straight lines, and the Luvo, Lungezy, and Luvemba thalwegs. Printed 964–965 gives the annex trace priority over inconsistent text. Actual Jentgen pages 77–78 describe subsequent 1924/1925 verification and 1927 Mpozo–Duizi changes. Consequently a generic 1891 parallel, generic river line, or a marker from another segment cannot qualify this Zaire exclusion.
source_relative_argument.source_construction: The exact native feature identity and geometry hash are preserved. Its named-feature relation to the 2019 Census Zaire record is documented; that comparator was processed from HDX ADM2 through the Lovua split, LSIB alignment, and ADM1 dissolution. This is specific evidence about the comparator family, not proof that exact Zaire sourceData coordinates or the disputed segment match it. COD’s source documents atlas digitization, watercourse splitting, topology and name validation, and assignment of undefined projection to WGS84; it gives no exact frontier edge convention.
source_relative_argument.mismatch_assessment: The native interior result establishes overlap in the consumed representation. No executed source reading establishes which of the COD or Zaire exported edges is displaced, nor a defensible clearance of these 25 cells. Different construction histories alone are not such evidence. Uige’s inherited coordinate comparison cannot transfer to Zaire.
source_relative_argument.reasonable_failed_qualification: The original 1913 text was obtained and read after overcoming the reader size limit through a separately approved download; relevant pages were visually checked. Its specifically named maps were sought in the retained volume using text and low-text page inspection, without finding an applicable annex. The official Cartothèque inventory locates Noqui–Kwango sheets rather than resolving their fine controls. The exact AGO ADM1 raw route remains restricted and was not retried. The bounded five-root local search found the descriptor and comparators, but no exact original ZIP. A 2017 OCHA Songololo map page returned 403 and remains stopped.
source_relative_argument.proposal_basis: The proposed unresolved treatment is based on actual primary instrument reading, source construction comparison, targeted annex and custody investigation, and failed exact-source qualification—not the native overlap or absent metadata alone. The evidence supports submitting these exact 25 cells for independent consideration as extensively researched but still unresolved. It does not claim every source opportunity is exhausted.
source_relative_argument.remaining_finite_step: A lawful already-retained exact AGO ADM1 source body, if later found, could settle the Zaire archive/output relation. The specific cartographic custody lead is State Archives portfolio 35/card 22, DEL.L-C.5A-C plus 5BIS B-D, Noqui–Kwango annex sheets; reading an applicable sheet could test the surveyed segment. No exact accessible sheet body was identified in the completed work. Custodian contact has not been authorized or sent. Exact AGO sourceData retrieval is still restricted; this proposal does not authorize a retry. Any later accessible body must be verified against its authenticated descriptor before use.
source_relative_argument.scope_exclusions: Cabinda Section A, Kasai survey controls, and Uige-specific equivalence are not used to decide the Zaire contact. Empty municipal kinds are only native-predicate absence.

Jentgen’s 1925 verification and 1927 changes limit reliance on older descriptions. These interstate provisions do not determine municipal interior limits or establish a held cell’s side.

groups.name: Tshela3/Niari
groups.status: author proposal only; all holds retained

source_relative_argument.native_question: All three exact Tshela keys have the native interior kind for original COG ADM1 Niari, feature ordinal 6, negative ordinal 6. All nine other original operands have empty kinds, including the AGO Cabinda family and COG ADM2 polygons. Those operands remain in the packet; their absence under this predicate is not political clearance.
source_relative_argument.historical_rule: Actual text of the 23 December 1908 declaration, reproduced in the 1909 bill and approving law of 13 June 1911, identifies the Kiama–Bembo ridge route and recognizes the mixed commission’s whole-frontier map and minutes as its documentary control. Actual Jentgen pages 31–32 and 65–67 distinguish treaty precision from demarcation, and report ratification exchange on 4 April 1912. This is substantive frontier context, but the executed readings do not establish that the three keys lie on that particular ridge subsegment. Manyanga 1903 and the Cabinda 1913 river/pond rules are separate.
source_relative_argument.source_construction: The exact COG ADM1 source ZIP was obtained, size/hash verified, and its DBF, XML, metadata, and licence image read. Niari is record 6 / CG-9, matching the named original feature. The archive attributes 2017 OSM/Wambacher and documents later field processing, but supplies no OSM relation version or extract snapshot. Name/ISO correspondence is not archive-to-output coordinate equivalence. COD’s atlas digitization and watercourse-splitting history likewise does not establish the disputed modern frontier convention.
source_relative_argument.mismatch_assessment: The native interior contact now identifies Niari specifically, eliminating the need to use Cabinda or distant COG ADM2 explanations for these holds. Neither the recovered OSM archive nor the declaration demonstrates an erroneous Niari edge or a valid target-side clearance. No historical landmark is georeferenced using unsupported modern coordinates, and no ridge/DEM constructor is introduced.
source_relative_argument.reasonable_failed_qualification: The earlier ZIP obstacle was resolved by a separately approved exact-source download, so it is not retained as a current blocker. The declaration, approving-law reproduction, Jentgen study, and official AE1 custody descriptions were actually read. The declaration supplies no numeric modern control table. The inspected archive does not identify the OSM history needed to tie a frontier edit to the exact representation. AE1 item 464 / AE(327) and the companion AE(255) descriptions provide custody leads, not an exposed definitive map body; targeted discovery did not identify that digital annex. The subsequent v16 primary-body read visually verified all12 Chamber pages, doc233 and declaration23December1908; no definitive map is included. The precise Tshela2016 OCHA map page returned403 and was stopped. The old v15 citation saying no local Chamber bytes/pixels were read is superseded by this verified v16 evidence.
source_relative_argument.proposal_basis: The proposed researched-unresolved treatment rests on a specific failed qualification after actual legal-text, source-archive, and custody investigation. It does not rely on missing metadata alone, pretend that Kiama–Bembo was bound to these cells, or demand an impossible universal sovereignty certificate. These three exact cells can be independently assessed on the completed source-relative work with the remaining historical-control limitation fully visible.
source_relative_argument.remaining_finite_step: Consult the specifically referenced mixed-commission map/minutes through the AE1 custody route, first verifying that the item covers the relevant Tshela segment and has usable controls. An authenticated OSM relation/extract identity for this consumed Niari feature would be a separate lineage lead if it becomes available. No exact digitized map URL or archive-supplied relation identity was found in the executed work; neither universal absence nor future impossibility is claimed. The stopped Tshela2016 OCHA map remains unread; no alternate copy request or access bypass is authorized by this proposal.
source_relative_argument.scope_exclusions: Cabinda primary readings do not qualify Niari. The 1903 Manyanga marker set does not automatically bind this cluster. The original Niari ZIP is now available; only the more specific representation/control relation remains unresolved.
